svg.text: Real board photograph with drawn connections — not a photo of an assembled circuit.
1. Unplug USB. Connect the four wires and the yellow GPIO0 jumper.
2. Connect USB to MB. Press RESET on the camera board, then upload.
3. Remove the yellow jumper. Press camera RESET to run.
Socket counts are from the TOP of this photo. Match your board variant; use only MB USB power.
Photo: Rui Santos / Sara Santos, Random Nerd Tutorials — upload-code-esp32-cam-mb-usb
